scope: N2 diagnostic using existing HOST public APIs. One validated force-history packet per case, all six original owners, original four-node bending cloth and 2 kg platform. Reverse and shifted are instrumentation inputs, not constitutive equilibrium targets. No product or default contact change.
rule: Integrate each original degree-seven Bernstein macro exactly. For reversed histories reverse order, coefficient order and times. L=B/h, R=J-L are nonnegative linear temporal shape weights. L maps to represented held cloth forces and robot world COM force/torque, R to one terminal point batch using the selected endpoint Jacobians and both sides' actual points. No second copy of J, no host state repair, no generalized-effort stand-in. A provisional and a terminal-wrapped replay both begin from the same original snapshot. Bind complete selected prestate/diagnostics to terminal prestate/diagnostics and compare delivered impulse and endpoint. One applied terminal batch per candidate.
checks: From the complete saved curves, independently obtain J and B (integrate in power basis) and compare to participant state changes. Same J, different B must yield matching final v and q=-B/2 for each profile within original 1e-8 m. Shift +1/12 share from Ua to Ub, compare delivered spatial channels/terminal point witnesses, final cloth moment and robot generalized response. A reconstructed world action or a prismatic-axis momentum does not independently measure a guide reaction. Preserve all failures.
path_energy: Public zero-budget complete prism/patch sweep and both endpoint bounds. Also check all six lifted gaps and the initial lower-vertex directional derivative on the reported affine chord. For nonadmissible path record penetration, original external/gravity work and initial layer storage; do not credit or certify layer energy/dissipation beyond hard contact. No successor state for an unsafe candidate. A delay, nonlinear material law or future coupled solver is not certified by these metrology controls.
budget_source: Unchanged limits in the fixture and scalar wire. 63 macros, 504 finite nonnegative coefficient words, each saved history gap-free, checksum and caller original state/material/scene/patch bound. Reject mutated time, owner, input binding or digest before a physical trial. No retries of already-complete cases.
